Container.Name: NexCraft-Web-Test
Container.Overview:
TEST STACK — runs the :test image (a feature branch), with its OWN data dir so it never touches your production NexCraft. Give this container its own IP and pair it with NexCraft-Daemon-Test.
This is the WEB (panel) container. After both Test containers are running, open the web UI, complete first-time setup, and add the Test daemon node (default 24444) using the access key from the Test daemon's data/Config/global.json. Docs: https://dpavlakis.github.io/NexCraft/
Container.Requires: Also install the NexCraft-Daemon-Test container — the panel needs a daemon node to run servers. This is a TEST stack; keep its data separate from production.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: TEST panel data (users, settings, registered daemons). Kept under nexcraft-test so it never touches production.
